representation: grasp rectangle drawn on the scene, square view at 2.6x the grasp size, resized to 336px; height-above-table (0-150mm) as a second VLM image (two_images)

width_shortcut_baseline.rule: predict good when the gripper gap is narrower than the threshold

note: Split by source image; accuracy measured by comparing yes/no token logits rather than parsing generated text. The width shortcut baseline shows what rectangle geometry alone achieves, so the fine-tuned number can be judged against it.
